title: Queue Sim
statement: Implement `solve(ops)`. Each op is `["enq", value]` or `["deq"]`. Values are integers. Start with an empty deque. For an enqueue, append to the right and record the string `ok`. For a dequeue, record the removed integer, or the string `error` if the deque is empty. Return the list of those records. Do not use a list pop from the front.
hints: append for enqueue, popleft for dequeue.
editorial: list.pop(0) is linear because every later element shifts. deque.popleft is constant time. The simulation records both the successful values and the empty pop so a caller can see the error instead of an exception.
